title: Auto Smelt
description: A simple datapack that auto smelts ores upon mining—Also works with fortune!
body:
## ⭐ clark's Auto Smelt
Ever get tired of having to mine for coal and wait for your ores to smelt? Well, look no further! This simple and useful data pack can make your life so much easier. It automatically smelt ores upon mining and even works with fortune. 

| Ore            | Drop             |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|
| Iron Ore            | Iron Ingots              |
| Copper Ore            | Copper Ingots             |
| Gold Ore/Nether Gold Ore            | Gold Ingots              |
| Ancient Debris | Netherite Scrap |
